HOLLOW BLADE

Slash with both thumbs. Avoid red bombs.

CUSTOMIZE

BLADE TRAIL

HOW TO PLAY

  • Swipe to slash - use both thumbs.
  • Cyan, violet and green foes: any slash (violet needs a fast, strong swipe).
  • Amber armoured foes: slash along the arrow (within 35 deg).
  • Never touch the red bombs.
  • Chain kills to fill FOCUS, then tap the bar (or Space) for slow-mo.
  • 3 hearts, no refills.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Take a breath. The next wave starts when you tap.

PAUSED

Take your time.
